Hi,
yes, currently it is not possible to specify the ylim argument of the activity plots. As David said, that is a job for the overlapPlot() function of the overlap package.
Here is a function to convert clock time to radial time though:


ClocktimeToTimeRad <- function(Clocktime,
                               timeformat = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"){
  
  DateTime2 <- strptime(as.character(Clocktime), format = timeformat, tz = "UTC")
  Time2     <- format(DateTime2, format = "%H:%M:%S", usetz = FALSE)
  Time.rad  <- (as.numeric(as.POSIXct(strptime(Time2, format = "%H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC"))) -
                  as.numeric(as.POSIXct(strptime("0", format = "%S", tz = "UTC")))) / 3600 * (pi/12)
  return(Time.rad)
}

recordTable$TimeRad <- ClocktimeToTimeRad(recordTable$DateTimeOriginal)

Cheers,
Jürgen
